newsitem.title: USA: Summit Technology seeks FDA nod for Apex.
newsitem.headline: Summit Technology seeks FDA nod for Apex.

text.p: Summit Technology Inc said on Friday it submitted a pre-market approval supplement to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for its Apex Plus excimer laser system to treat astigmatism.
Summit said the submission is the first step in the approval process for the treatment system, which uses an erodible laser disk.

In a statement, Summit quoted Dr. Michael Gordon, the medical monitor for the clinical study, as saying post-operative data indicate that results from Apex Plus "stabilized between 3-6 months and that the patients' visual acuity meet the FDA's suggested criteria for efficacy."
Apex Plus already has been used outside the United States for two years to treat various eye problems, Summit said, and was approved by the FDA in February for treatment of nearsightedness.
Summit shares closed up 1/8, at 5-5/8, on Friday.
